title: Founder's Office Executive (Founder's Associate / Strategy & Ops)
description:
**Job Description**

**HavStrategy**

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years (relevant)

CTC: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month

**About HavStrategy**

HavStrategy is a data-driven digital marketing and performance growth agency that helps D2C, eCommerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, and consumer brands achieve sustainable business growth through innovative marketing strategies, performance marketing, branding, data analytics, and business consulting.

As a Founder's Office Executive, you will work directly with the founders and leadership team, driving strategic initiatives, business operations, and cross-functional execution with a high degree of ownership. This role is ideal for a self-driven professional who can independently manage projects, translate strategy into execution, and act as a trusted extension of the founders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic & Business Support**

* Partner with the founders on strategic business initiatives, high-priority projects, and organizational goal-setting.
* Own end-to-end business planning, execution tracking, and performance monitoring against goals.
* Lead market research, industry analysis, competitor benchmarking, and trend analysis to inform decisions.
* Identify and evaluate growth opportunities through market insights and business data.
* Independently prepare business proposals, strategy documents, and board/leadership-ready reports.

**Project Management & Operations**

* Drive coordination across departments to ensure timely, high-quality completion of projects.
* Own project timelines, deliverables, and key milestones, escalating risks proactively.
* Build and maintain project trackers, SOPs, dashboards, and documentation frameworks.
* Identify process gaps and lead operational workflow improvements.
* Ensure smooth, accountable execution of founder-led initiatives from concept to closure.

**Research & Data Analysis**

* Own the collection, structuring, and analysis of business data.
* Prepare and present MIS reports and business performance dashboards to leadership.
* Translate data into insights that support strategic decision-making.
* Conduct competitor analysis and market intelligence research.
* Present research findings with clear, actionable recommendations.

**Communication & Coordination**

* Plan and run meetings — set agendas, record MOMs, and drive follow-up on action items.
* Collaborate closely with HR, Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Finance teams.
* Manage client communication and correspondence where required.
* Support founders in stakeholder management and external business correspondence.

**Documentation & Presentation**

* Create polished presentations, reports, proposals, and business documentation.
* Prepare investor decks, client presentations, and internal leadership reports.
* Maintain and organize critical business records and documentation systems.

**Administrative & Founder Support**

* Manage scheduling, calendars, and priorities for the founders.
* Support founders across daily operational and strategic activities.
* Handle confidential business information with the highest professionalism and discretion.
* Ensure seamless coordination across all business functions.

**Required Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive)
* Microsoft PowerPoint / Google Slides
* Data Analysis & Reporting
* Market & Business Research
* MIS Reporting
* Documentation & SOP Creation
* Dashboard & Tracker Management
* Financial Analysis (basic to intermediate)
* Presentation Design
* AI Productivity Tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Notion AI)
* CRM Tools (preferred)
* Project Management Tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, Notion, Monday.com)
* Working Knowledge of Digital Marketing and Business Growth

**Core Skills**

* Strong analytical and strategic thinking
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Business acumen and sound judgment
* Critical thinking and independent decision-making
* High attention to detail
* Strong time management and prioritization
* Project ownership and coordination
* Organizational skills and multitasking
* Stakeholder management
* Ownership mindset and accountability
* Adaptability in a fast-paced environment
* Leadership and mentoring potential
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong follow-up and execution discipline
* Confidentiality and professionalism

**Preferred Knowledge**

Candidates with knowledge of the following will have an advantage:

* Startup ecosystem and business operations
* Digital Marketing & Performance Marketing fundamentals
* Business Strategy and Product Management concepts
* Marketing Analytics and Business Process Optimization
* KPI Tracking and OKRs (Objectives & Key Results)
* Growth Marketing and Customer Journey Mapping
* Competitor Intelligence and Consumer Behaviour
* D2C & eCommerce business models
* Luxury & Lifestyle Brand Marketing
* AI tools for business productivity
* Basic Financial Statements and Business Metrics & Reporting

**Eligibility**

* MBA / BBA / B.Com / BMS / Economics / Marketing / Business Analytics, or related disciplines.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in Strategy, Operations, Business Development, Consulting, Project Management, Marketing, or Startup Operations.
* Candidates with prior Founder's Office, Chief of Staff, or similar high-ownership roles will be preferred.

**What We're Looking For**

* A proactive professional who takes complete ownership of tasks and outcomes.
* Someone who enjoys solving complex business problems independently.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Curious learner with a strong growth mindset.
* Sharp execution skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders efficiently.
* Genuine passion for startups, strategy, and business growth.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Work directly with the Founders and Leadership Team.
* Significant ownership of business strategy, operations, and decision-making.
* Cross-functional exposure to Marketing, HR, Sales, Operations, and Strategy.
* Fast-paced learning environment with high growth potential.
* Direct mentorship from experienced founders and leadership.
* Clear career growth path within HavStrategy.
* Opportunity to shape and lead high-impact business initiatives.

**Why Join HavStrategy?**

At HavStrategy, you'll take on a role with real impact and responsibility. As a Founder's Office Executive, you'll work alongside the leadership team, own high-impact business initiatives, and build deep expertise in strategy, operations, project management, analytics, and business growth — an ideal launchpad for a career in consulting, business strategy, operations, product management, or entrepreneurial leadership.

Founder's Office, Founder's Associate, Executive Assistant to Founder, Chief of Staff, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Special Projects, Growth, MBA Freshers, Management Trainee, D2C Brands, Digital Marketing Agency, Noida, In-Office, Immediate Joiner

description:
**Position:** Senior Director, HR Business Partner
  
**Business Unit:** Employee Experience
  
**Location:** Noida
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
Adobe is looking for a Senior Director, HR Business Partner to lead the HR Business partnering team across BUs in India while leading the people and organization agenda globally for the Adobe Document Cloud business.
  
  
Based in Noida, this leader will work directly with senior Product, Engineering and Research executives as they scale the business and advance AI-led innovation.This is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of technology, product, AI, talent and organizational scale.
  
  
You will lead a group of senior HR professionals, work across a complex global matrix and help leaders rethink how work, teams and capabilities should evolve in an AI-enabled world. You will be a member of the India Employee Experience leadership team and the global business-unit Employee Experience leadership team, and will represent India Employee Experience in global business-partner forums when required.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Product, Engineering and AI Partnership

* Understand product roadmaps, engineering priorities, technology investments and AI strategieswell enough to anticipate organizational and talent implications.
* Translate business and technology priorities into workforce, talent, leadership and organizationalstrategies.

AI-Enabled Organization and Workforce Design

* Use workforce data, organizational analytics and scenario modeling to identify organizational friction, duplicated capability, decision bottlenecks and skill gaps.
* Help leaders assess how AI changes workflows, roles, skills, team composition and the balance between automated, augmented and human-led work.
* Partner with People Analytics, Finance, Talent Acquisition and business leaders on workforceinvestment, capability planning and organizational health.
* Ensure human judgment, fairness, transparency and appropriate governance remain central toAI-enabled organizational and talent decisions.

Talent and Leadership
  

* Build forward-looking strategies to attract, retain and develop exceptional engineering, product,AI, data and research talent.
* Partner with leaders on pivotal roles, scarce skills, succession risks, capability gaps and differentiated career paths for technical and management talent.
* Coach executives through transformation, ambiguity, rapid technological change and evolving team structures.
* Strengthen leadership expectations around technical excellence, product thinking, AI fluency, execution, accountability and talent development.

Team and Culture Leadership

* Use engagement, talent, attrition, productivity, skills and organizational data to understand organizational health and guide intervention.
* Help create a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, innovation, responsible AI adoption, execution discipline and continuous learning.

What you need to succeed
  
  

* 18+ years of progressive HR or HR business partnering leadership experience, with substantial experience supporting Product, Engineering, Technology, R&D, AI or Research organizations.
* At least two years operating at Senior Director level or in a role of comparable enterprise scope, with the potential to grow into broader leadership over time.
* Deep understanding of modern technology organizations, including software engineering, product management, data and AI, platform or research environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex organizational design and transformation in a global,technology-driven environment.
* A strong track record in workforce planning, operating-model transformation, talent strategy, leadership development, succession planning and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience using data, analytics, workforce modeling or AI-enabled tools to inform organizational decisions.
* The credibility and judgment to influence highly technical executives, challenge conventional thinking and operate effectively across a complex global matrix.
* Strong business and technology acumen, with comfort discussing product roadmaps, engineering organizations, AI adoption, technical talent and delivery models.

title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
**Job Description - Senior Atlassian Admin**

**About Rightsline:**

At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the world’s most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology.

Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control.

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference.

**What You Will Own:**

**Instance Configuration & Governance**

* Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes.
* Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires — establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step.
* Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery
* Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects.
* Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use.
* Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes.

**Workflow, Automation & App Administration**

* Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration — and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration.
* Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state.
* Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus.
* Administer our Marketplace apps — including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent.

**Confluence & Process Documentation**

* Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy.
* Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives.
* Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes.

**Reporting, Data & Integrations**

* Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence.
* Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost.
* Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely.
* Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus.
* Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors.

**Access, Compliance & Support**

* Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when.
* Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management.
* Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks

**What You Bring:**

* 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration.
* Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management).
* ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps.
* Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics.
* Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires.
* Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection.
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira.
* Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change.
* Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping.
* Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates.
* Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations.
* Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction.
* Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on.
* Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative.
* Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones.

**Work Environment & Expectations:**

* Noida/NCR based
* Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts. Regular overlap with US-based engineering leadership, targeting 4 hours daily.
* Compliance with security and remote working policies

**Compensation & Growth:**

Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.

**Life at Rightsline India:**

At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success.  
We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:

* Provident Fund, Gratuity, and all statutory benefits in compliance with applicable Indian labour laws
* Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents
* Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security
* In-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks
* Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days
* Flexible working hours, role-dependent
* Structured and transparent leave policy
* Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization
* Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support
* Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs

You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.

title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Administration
description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – HR Administration**

*Global Process Owner, HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle (A2W)*

**Tower**

Administer to Work (A2W)

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Employee data management, lifecycle events (joiners, movers, leavers), HR documentation, time and attendance, and records management

  

**Grade**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own HR administration and employee data for every country moving into Noida. You will replace manual, country-specific administration with one digital, standardised lifecycle process. The goal is employee data that stays accurate, compliant and trusted, because every other tower depends on it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map current joiner, mover and leaver processes, document practices and time-and-attendance set-ups in each country, and set the baseline.
* Design the A2W target operating model, covering data ownership, maker-checker rules, local document requirements and handoffs to R2P and R2H.
* Lead country-by-country transition, including data cleansing before migration, knowledge transfer and stabilisation.
* Retire legacy manual and fragmented time-and-attendance tools as each country moves across.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for A2W. Own lifecycle process standards for internal moves, promotions, demotions, transfers, contract changes and exits.
* Own employee master-data quality through validation rules, regular audits and data-quality dashboards.
* Run offboarding that is compliant and humane, covering final documents, access removal, knowledge transfer and exit feedback.
* Integrate time and attendance with payroll, with near-real-time sync and a minimum of manual touchpoints.
* Act as the escalation point for lifecycle and data issues.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own controls on data changes, including maker-checker, audit trails and privileged-access reviews.
* Keep records retention and data privacy compliant with GDPR and local law in every country.
* Hold audit-ready evidence for all lifecycle transactions.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Digitise HR administration end to end through automated document generation, e-signature and digital personnel files.
* Automate high-volume transactions with RPA and workflow tools.
* Use workforce data and predictive analytics to support planning in the business.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: A2W operating model, data-quality baseline and document-digitisation plan agreed.
